title: Blockcassone Composition
description: Top-level canonical artwork definition. Contains only the data needed to deterministically reproduce the artwork structure. Visual style (colours, glow, animation) lives in the renderer — not here.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Increment on breaking changes.

seed.description: Deterministic seed. All randomness (material assignment, edge patterns, placement order) derives from this hash.

order.description: Hilbert order k. Produces 8^k vertices, 8^(k-1) cube motifs, and 3×8^(k-1) planes.

placement.description: How planes are selected for inclusion in this composition.

strategy.description: 'jigsaw' = edge-compatible neighbor-first. 'random' = unconstrained. 'fill_all' = every valid plane.

includeBoundary.description: Whether boundary planes (spanning two adjacent motifs) are eligible.

params.description: Structural generation parameters baked into the plane data. Changing these changes the canonical output, not just its appearance.

edgeSubdivisions.description: Sub-vertex divisions per plane edge. Determines the length of each plane's edgePatterns arrays.

edgePointProbability.description: Probability each sub-vertex is active (1). Seeded by the composition hash.

tokens.description: Placed tokens. Each entry is a token occupying one cube slot. See token.json.
